meta.title: Book a Session | Essentia
meta.description: Book your session at Essentia, Santa Cruz de Tenerife: manual and facial therapies, red light and IV therapy. Pay online when you book.

heading: Book a session.
subheading: Choose your service, pick a time, and we will take care of the rest.

memberBlocker.title: Active membership found
memberBlocker.body: This email is linked to an active Essentia membership. Sign in to book with your member benefits.

serviceStep.label: Which service would you like to book?

manual-therapies.title: Manual Therapies
manual-therapies.description: Precise manual work to release tension and restore mobility.

facial-therapies.title: Therapeutic Facials
facial-therapies.description: Advanced facial protocols combining manual techniques and technology for radiant skin health.

contrast-therapy.title: Contrast Therapy
contrast-therapy.description: Alternating heat and cold to activate recovery and reduce inflammation.

breathing-sessions.title: Breathing Sessions
breathing-sessions.description: Guided breathwork to shift from stress to active recovery.

red-light-therapy.title: Red Light Therapy
red-light-therapy.description: Red and infrared light to stimulate cellular repair and regeneration.

hyperbaric-chambers.title: Hyperbaric Oxygen
hyperbaric-chambers.description: Pressurised oxygen to accelerate tissue repair and reduce inflammation.

intravenous-therapy.title: IV Therapy
intravenous-therapy.description: Personalised intravenous protocols with vitamins, minerals and micronutrients, always under medical assessment.

regenerative-medicine.title: Regenerative Medicine
regenerative-medicine.description: Protocols that activate your body's own repair mechanisms.

durationStep.label: Choose a duration
durationStep.fixedDescription: This service has a fixed session type.
durationStep.noneAvailable: No session types available for this service.
durationStep.therapistDescription: Select your therapist preference for this session.
durationStep.staffDescription: Choose who you would like for your session.
durationStep.noStaffTitle: This session type is not available right now
durationStep.noStaffBody: No practitioner is assigned to this treatment at the moment. Write to us and we will find a way to see you.

datetimeStep.noSlotsAvailable: No slots available for this date
datetimeStep.timeGone: That time is no longer available. Please choose another.

detailsStep.notesPlaceholderShort: Anything we should know before your session? (optional)
detailsStep.consentNoticeSuffix: , and agree to receive my booking confirmation and reminder by email and WhatsApp.
detailsStep.purposeValue: managing your booking and notifying you about your appointment (confirmation and reminder, by email and WhatsApp); only if you tick the news and offers box, sending you news and offers by email and WhatsApp
detailsStep.legalBasisValue: performance of the service you book (GDPR art. 6.1.b) for the booking and the notices about your appointment; your consent (art. 6.1.a) for news and offers
detailsStep.optOutValue: you can withdraw your consent to news and offers at any time: with the unsubscribe link in each email (stops the emails) and by replying STOP on WhatsApp (stops all our WhatsApp messages, including your appointment notices).
detailsStep.rightsValue: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection: write to
detailsStep.newsletterOptIn: I'd like to receive Essentia news and offers by email and WhatsApp.

confirmStep.name: Name
confirmStep.cancellationNote: Your booking is confirmed by the payment. You can change or cancel it up to 24 hours before the session; if you cancel, we refund what you paid. Within the last 24 hours, or if you do not turn up, there is no refund.
confirmStep.alreadyConfirmed: This booking was already confirmed. If you need to change it, please contact us.
confirmStep.payFullNote: You pay {now} today and nothing later.

paymentOverlay.takingYou: We are taking you to the Redsys payment gateway.

successState.heading: Booking requested.
successState.contactNote: We will contact you by phone or WhatsApp at {phone} to confirm your appointment.

confirmation.heading: Booking confirmed.
confirmation.body: Your payment has been processed and your appointment is confirmed. See you soon!
confirmation.contactNote: A confirmation has been sent to your email.
confirmation.contactNoteWithPhone: A confirmation has been sent to your email and to <phone>{phoneValue}</phone>.

alreadyPaid.heading: This booking is already paid.
alreadyPaid.body: No new charge was made. Your appointment is confirmed and the payment confirmation was already sent to your email.

requested.heading: Request received.
requested.body: We've received your request and will be in touch shortly to confirm your appointment.
requested.contactNote: Please keep an eye on your email. We will reach out to confirm your appointment.
requested.contactNoteWithPhone: Please keep an eye on your email and phone <phone>{phoneValue}</phone>. We will reach out to confirm your appointment.
requested.bodyUnpaid: The payment could not be started and the hour is not reserved. Please try again or write to us.

confirm.heading: Cancel your appointment?
confirm.body: You can cancel at no cost.
confirm.bodyRefund: You can cancel at no cost. We will refund the {amount} you paid online.

done.heading: Appointment cancelled
done.body: Your appointment is cancelled and the slot is free again.
done.bodyRefund: Your appointment is cancelled and the slot is free again. We will refund the {amount} you paid online to the same card; it may take a few days to show.

late.heading: Too late to cancel online
late.body: Your session is less than 24 hours away. Call or write to us and we will see what we can do.

already.heading: This appointment was already cancelled
already.body: There is nothing left to do. Book again whenever you like.

missing.heading: Invalid link
missing.body: This link does not match any appointment. Check that you copied all of it from your email.
